scientific_question: Can a tiny state-dependent diagonal chart extension recover useful attention directions that the fixed one-percent BlockFHT tangent misses?

execution.performance_gate: synchronously polled exact real-training preflight with MFU >= 20%
execution.scientific_run: dedicated persistent tmux supervisor with direct foreground polling; no watchdog and no callbacks
execution.provenance: commit, entrypoint, literal command, archived config SHA256, source hashes, dataset manifest, runtime evaluation digest, and MFU certificate

decision_rule.hard_reject: NaN, Inf, nonzero exit, or terminal validation CE more than 0.02 worse than 5.4918
decision_rule.selection: Among stable candidates at or within 0.02 of the control, prefer the lowest terminal validation CE; within 0.01 prefer output-only over input-only and either one-sided chart over bilateral.
decision_rule.promotion: Promote at most one candidate to 124M/5TPP. The 0.5TPP rung is a stability/early-fit screen because the base attention replacement is already tied with dense there; closure must be judged at 5TPP and then 20TPP.
